I have only this small piece of land, so I cannot afford to buy chemical fertilizer from the market. I will use the poultry manure I have saved to give strength to the soil, and I will plant the same cassava cuttings my mother taught me to use. The rains have been good enough here in the South East, so I do not need to irrigate, and my children will help me with the weeding and harvesting.
